title: Order in the Court: Why did SC junk petitions vs Duterte’s ICC arrest?
summary: How did this happen? Watch this episode with Jairo Bolledo.

blocks.text: How did this happen? Watch this episode with Jairo Bolledo.
MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court dismissed the habeas corpus petitions of former president Rodrigo Duterte’s children questioning his International Criminal Court arrest.
Duterte has been detained in The Hague, Netherlands, since March 2025.
According to the High Court, habeas corpus, or the writ against illegal detention, was not the proper remedy in his case.
